adjudication.evidence: P1 (single-day spike at 535) lacks sustained shift or return; P2 (545–546) shows a brief jump but no opposing return and is likely part of ongoing motion; P3 (550–612) exhibits a large onset offset but the residual after subtraction (Hypothesis P3) shows persistent non-zero trend without clear return—U component remains offset, N/E show drift, not closure. No candidate satisfies the definition of a temporary platform: sustained shift followed by opposing return across same axes. Independent permanent step at ~550 (per nuisance_step_days) further disfavors P3 as temporary.
